violated_contract: A serving Firestore query's required composite index must be declared in the repository index registry; an index that exists only as a hand-created live index (or not at all) leaves the query failing closed with FailedPrecondition in production.
canonical_prevention: Derive the required index signature from the production query builder itself in a behavioral test — record the equality filters and orderings the real read path builds, and assert the generated manifest declares the matching composite — so a new equality/ordering combination cannot ship without its index.
